description: Current weather plus daily forecast up to 16 days and optional hourly forecast up to 48 hours, worldwide. Current: temperature, feels like, humidity, wind and gusts, precipitation, cloud cover, pressure, conditions text. Daily: min/max, conditions, precipitation sum and probability, max wind, UV index, sunrise/sunset. Params: location (city name like 'Berlin' or 'lat,lon'), days (1 to 16, default 3), hours (0 to 48 hourly steps, default 0), units ('metric' default or 'imperial'). forecast_3d is kept for older clients. Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"location":"Berlin"}.

location.description: City name (e.g. 'Berlin'), or lat,lon string (e.g. '52.52,13.41'). Default: Berlin
